info.name: Hip-Hop
info.description: Boom bap, trap half time, neo soul keys and a lo-fi hip-hop song.

songs.name: Lo-fi Hip-Hop
songs.description: A lo-fi hip-hop song in C at 84 BPM, all synth sounds, swung: intro, verse, hook, verse, hook, bridge, hook and outro on the four Lo-fi Hip-Hop patterns, over Dm9, G13, Cmaj9 and Am7. The piano's filter opens over the intro; the drums drop out for the last beat before each hook; the bell throws into the echo at the end of the last hook, and over the outro the piano fades into the dust.

patterns.name: Boom Bap
patterns.description: Boom bap, 1 measure: kick on 1, 1&, 2&, 3& and 3a, snare on 2, 2a, 3e and 4e, 8th hats with 32nd figures every 3 to 6 passes, open hat on each &; clap rolls on 2 and 4 every 2 and 4 passes.

patterns.name: Neo Soul Keys
patterns.description: Neo soul over the boom bap drums, 4 measures: electric piano on Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7, a long chord on 1 and a pushed one on 2a and 3e with the top notes softer.

patterns.name: Hip-Hop
patterns.description: Hip-hop, 2 measures: kick on 1a, 2& and 3&, snare on 2 and 4 with a 4& 4a pickup at the end, swung 16th hats, open hat on each a, clap on 2e and around 4.

patterns.name: Trap Half-Time
patterns.description: Trap with a half-time snare on 3, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 2& with a roll on 3& every 2 passes, clap with the snare, 8th hats with 16th rolls on 3 and 4, open hat and crash on 4&; tom roll every 8 passes.

patterns.name: Lo-fi Hip-Hop Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Lo-fi Hip-Hop demo, 4 measures in C at 84 BPM, all synth sounds: lazy electric piano chords (Dm9, G13, Cmaj9, Am7), low-passed, saturated and gently wobbling, over vinyl dust.

patterns.name: Lo-fi Hip-Hop Verse
patterns.description: The verse of the Lo-fi Hip-Hop demo, 4 measures in C at 84 BPM, swung: a dusty boom bap kick and snare with ghost notes, crushed hats, a round sub bass on the roots and the lazy piano chords.

patterns.name: Lo-fi Hip-Hop Hook
patterns.description: The hook of the Lo-fi Hip-Hop demo, 4 measures in C at 84 BPM: the verse with a pentatonic bell line in tape echo and a warm pad under the chords.

patterns.name: Lo-fi Hip-Hop Bridge
patterns.description: The bridge of the Lo-fi Hip-Hop demo, 4 measures in C: no kick, the snare and the hats alone with the pad, the piano and the bell.
